title: Key West Private Charter: Sandbar and Snorkeling
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
This private charter is designed for a relaxed, flexible day on the water, perfect for groups who want a casual, unstructured experience. Instead of a formal, guided eco-tour, this trip offers a more laid-back vibe, allowing you to create your own adventure.
Connect with Key West's abundant wildlife as you cruise the waters in search of our resident coastal dolphins. From there, we'll head to a secluded sandbar, a pristine shallow-water oasis where you can unwind and enjoy the tranquility.

This tour is ideal for those who prefer to relax and socialize. Spend your time floating, swimming, or simply lounging with a cold beverage in hand. While snorkeling is an option, it is not a guided activity on this trip, making it perfect for guests who are more interested in a leisurely day on the water than a structured snorkel excursion.

We'll provide a snack of fresh, organic fruit from Date & Thyme, and the trip is BYOB so you can bring your favorite drinks.
